recordMeaning: All allowed body fields and dynamic sources; future exact bytes depend on actual model/tool results and are not pre-fabricated.

decision.candidateSetId: null or current per-search12-byte nonce/base64url; not session/citation token
decision.question: 我这门选修课没过，能不能重修？
decision.userConditions: {} first run; courseType=PUBLIC only after independently verified qualified question

rejectedActions.source: structured domain events, no free-text model reason

availableConditions.source: conditions from actually read reviewed rule contexts

decision.publicationFactIds: Sorted distinct already-read facts with registered capability and original full-definition fingerprint match; no raw UUID/checksum

input.inputFingerprint: SHA256 bound to task/version/safe question/facts/capabilities/condition directory; original IDs not sent
input.userConditions: same verified user-declared conditions as decision

review.reviewContract: exact static review description with conditional-branch instruction
review.responseConditionIdBoundary: necessaryConditionIds must use original conditionId from input.conditions; prefixed/unknown keys rejected REVIEW_CONDITION_UNKNOWN

dynamicActionSchema: All current handles, allowed actions and publicationFactIds from the same host state; empty eligible list sets maxItems=0. All read facts/candidates retained; no default c1 or preselected answer.
notOutbound: prior final answer or semantic assessment
proposer action/reason/self-reported relevance in independent review input

localSnapshotOnly.credentialRedaction: Decoded JSON names/values and bounded nested Unicode scrub; malformed/unreliable JSON omitted, original SHA preserved; redacted=true is not exact original text
localSnapshotOnly.failurePolicy: Archive failure stops acceptance with AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE; no extra model quota for snapshot
